info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Detail Payment Instructions-spec
info.description: The Payment Instructions Retrieval API allows users to access detailed payment instructions associated with specific customer accounts. This endpoint serves financial institutions and service providers seeking to streamline payment processing for their clients. By fetching the payment instructions using customer and account identifiers, businesses can ensure accurate and timely transactions. Typical consumers include banking applications and fintech solutions that require access to up-to-date payment method information.

get.summary: Retrieve payment instructions for a specific account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the payment instructions associated with a particular account under a specific customer. It provides detailed information necessary for processing payments.

requestBody.description: Retrieves payment instruction details for the specified account. This includes information such as payment methods and instructions associated with account ACC-200045 for customer CUST-100045.

ListDetailPaymentInstructionsRequest.description: A string representation of the payment instructions for the specified account.

ListDetailPaymentInstructionsResponse_20.title: Payment Instructions Response

paymentInstruction.description: A list of payment instructions associated with the account.

ListDetailPaymentInstructionsResponse_20.description: Schema representing the response structure for payment instructions associated with a specific account.
